5289-7487-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5289-7487-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

6-5261-7014.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-5261-7014.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4556-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4556-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-4676-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

997-1086-1981-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
997-1086-1981-2415.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1116-1580-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2457-2557-4289-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

430-2743-5491-6222.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-2743-5491-6222.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least three token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Worldwalker Helm.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

254-2921--5.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2

661-3685-4030-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Starnheim Courser. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-5256-7217.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1308-1563-3480-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-1603-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Evil Twin.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evil Twin by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6114.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-4050-6114.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Skyknight Squire triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-2757-3327.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a basic Mountain.
2292-2757-3327.description:
Activate a basic Mountain, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dargo, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2908-5542-5554.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
You control at least one additional creature with mana value 2 or less that can be cast using colored mana.
2908-5542-5554.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {1}{U}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers twice, creating two copies of a Treasure token you control.
When Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and another creature with mana value 2 or less that can be cast using colored mana from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 4 one additional time if you do not have enough mana to cast the other creature returned to your hand in step 3.
Cast the other creature returned to your hand in step 3 by paying its mana cost.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers twice, creating two copies of a Treasure token you control.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
2908-5542-5554.notes: If the other creature has mana value 1 or less, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens, and you may either make Gnome tokens or copy other artifact tokens using Oltec Matterweaver's triggers.

744-2034-4052.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
"Pegasus" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
744-2034-4052.description:
Activate Pegasus Refuge by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Pegasus creature token.
When the Pegasus enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1562-4684-4824.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Soliton that is an artifact.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {U}, untapping it.
Mesemeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1082-4050-5152.description:
Cast Celestial Gatekeeper by paying {3}{W}{W}.
Celestial Gatekeeper enters the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature's first ability, creating a token copy of Celestial Gatekeeper.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Celestial Gatekeeper, adding {1}.
Celestial Gatekeeper dies, triggering itself and Dual Nature's second ability.
In response, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Celestial Gatekeeper token, adding {1}.
The Celestial Gateekeeper token dies, triggering itself, exiling itself and returning Celestial Gatekeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Celestial Gatekeeper enters the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature's first ability, creating a token copy of Celestial Gatekeeper.
Resolve the nontoken Celestial Gateekeeper's trigger, failing to exile itself and returning up to two more Birds and/or Clerics from your graveyard to the battlefield.
If you returned a creature this way, Dual Nature's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of that creature.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all triggers from Dual Nature's second ability, exiling all tokens with the same name as a creature card that left the battlefield during this combo.

1082-1769-2292.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Dual Nature.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling all tokens named Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger from step 2, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
The token copy of Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2302-4215-4240.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cavalier of Gales, adding {C}{C}.
Cavalier of Gales and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Cavalier of Gales trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Cavalier of Gales, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Cavalier of Gales enters the battlefield, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand on top of your library.
Repeat.

2626-3200-4986.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
